critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck hump primitive along its longitudinal axis to increase its length by 40%, ensuring it reaches further back toward the fuselage. Simultaneously, apply a fillet radius of 15% to the junction between the cylinder and the upper deck to smooth the curvature transition.

discrepancies.observed: The upper-deck hump ends abruptly near the front of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The hump extends significantly further back along the top of the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length along the longitudinal axis

discrepancies.observed: A sharp, distinct transition between the cylinder and the upper-deck section.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous curve blending into the main fuselage.

discrepancies.observed: The nose is a flat, vertical circular face.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: replace flat cylinder end with a spherical cap or cone

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears as a low-profile protrusion.
discrepancies.reference: A prominent, high-reaching upper deck structure.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical height of the upper-deck primitive
